user.title: Off-Grid Planner
user.description: Forecast-driven advice for tilting, shedding loads and running a generator. Location follows Home Assistant's home location. A shed-order to-do list is created with example loads: edit, reorder (top = shed first) or learn them.

data.generator_charge_w: Generator charging power into the battery
data.use_ensemble: Plan for a bad week (ensemble forecast)

data_description.soc_entity: Battery SOC sensor (%), ideally from a shunt.
data_description.system_factor: Measured output ÷ rated output at high sun (0.68 for a flat roof array).
data_description.baseline_w: Average battery draw of everything not on the shed list, excluding fridge and heat.
data_description.heat_w_per_degc: Furnace blower average watts per °C of outdoor temperature below 15 °C.
data_description.tilt_deg: How far the trailer can be tilted by day (0 = never).
data_description.tilt_azimuth: Compass direction the panels face when tilted (180 = south).
data_description.jack_wh_per_day: Energy to raise and lower the tongue jack once.
data_description.use_ensemble: Also downloads an ensemble forecast and plans against its darkest 10%.
data_description.battery_power_entity: Watts, positive while charging (e.g. a shunt power sensor updating every second).
data_description.pv_power_entity: Watts. Lets you learn loads by day; without it, learn at night or with steady sun. A full battery hides load changes.
